proof_boundary: Static review of both output artifacts and supplied source/contract/stale packet; independently executed JSON parsing and current SHA-256 comparisons. Recorded reproductions were inspected, not rerun or independently witnessed. This evaluates synthetic diagnosis outputs only, not real project behavior, an implemented fix, actual runtime model identity, or migration readiness.

findings.failure_mode: Incorrect Balanced classification undercuts the mandatory Deep floor even though the arm assignment was sol/high. This is a classification defect; no actual runtime downgrade is established.

unsupported_claims_or_limits: The two executed_reproductions.command strings are descriptive pseudocommands, not literal runnable shell transcripts. Results are source-consistent but their execution cannot be independently established from this artifact alone.
Actual model/effort, precise tool count, absence of every other filesystem write, and exactly-once delivery are not independently proved by output.json.
